thread:
sara: NewCorp's security team pinged asking for: (1) KMS envelope proof for tenant keys including rotation history, (2) RBAC change audit for infra/service accounts last 90d, (3) sample export showing log retention metadata + proof-of-export, and (4) our customer-facing vuln triage timeline and notification template.
ben: Acknowledge. They specifically want evidence that fallback model containers don't write to shared disk or KV caches. We should include the routing policy snippet and an explicit cache-partition note.
sara: Also requested HSM attestation for on-prem customers and an explanation of how key provenance ties to our rotation workflow. Keep tenant IDs redacted.
ricardo: I'll pull KMS rotation events (both CloudTrail and Cloud Audit Logs) and map key_alias -> created_at -> last_rotate_by -> last_rotate_ts. Will replace tenant IDs with "tenant-REDACTED" tokens.
aisha: For RBAC, plan: query audit logs for methods SetIamPolicy, SetIamPermissions, AddRoleBinding, RemoveRoleBinding filtered to principalType:SERVICE_ACCOUNT across clouds. I'll produce before/after binding diffs and a CSV summary.
ben: Command examples I will run (GCP):
```
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "SetIamPermission") AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:serviceAccount' --freshness=90d --format=json > /tmp/newcorp/iam_changes_90d.json
```
ricardo: For AWS KMS rotate events I'll query CloudTrail:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2026-01-01 --end-time 2026-03-31
```
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-5022: "NewCorp SQ evidence bundle (KMS/RBAC/logs/vuln-runbook)" assigned to @sara,@ben,@ricardo,@aisha. Due 2026-03-20 17:00 UTC.
sara: Delivery format: ZIP with README.pdf mapping each file to the SQ question, CSVs for rotations and RBAC diffs, one redacted JSON audit sample, routing_policy excerpt, and a short vuln-notify template (customer-facing). Use s3://redwood-sec/newcorp-1769500000/ for staging and set presigned links to expire in 7 days.
aisha: I'll add a manifest.csv column `sq_question_id` referencing the customer's questionnaire line numbers. Helps reviewers.
ricardo: Will include key attestation hash for on-prem HSM customers and reference the HSM vendor attestation doc (redacted).
ben: Add a short statement in the README clarifying that fallback models are executed in per-tenant sandboxes with no shared KV, and that cached prompts are tagged and scoped by tenant-id (never shared).
sara: Action items: Ricardo (KMS rotation CSV + HSM attestation pointer), Aisha (RBAC export + diffs + manifest), Ben (routing_policy excerpt + redact script), Sara (assemble README + upload + presigned links).
aisha: ETA for RBAC diffs: ~2h.
ricardo: KMS CSV + attestation pointers by EOD today.
ben: I'll prepare routing snippet and the short cache isolation blurb in ~90m.
sec-bot: Reminder: run PII redaction checklist prior to upload -> https://internal.redwood/sec/redaction-checklist. Automated scanner will run on upload.
sara: Good. If NewCorp requests live validation, offer a 30m read-only session using the evidence viewer. I'll propose that in the README.
ben: Noted. I'll post redacted samples to /tmp/newcorp_evidence and ping here when ready.
sara: Thanks team. Once I review, we'll upload and send presigned links to NewCorp's security contact.
